title: FHIR Integration Architect
description:
**About the Role**

 

We're building an independent FHIR R4 interoperability layer that lets our CRM's clinical workflows starting with provider launch directly from inside the EHR, beginning with Oracle Health (Cerner) PowerChart. We need someone who can do both halves of this job well: design and personally validate the technical architecture, and lead the engineers full-stack, AI, and QA who build it. This is not a design-and-handoff role. You'll be in the SMART on FHIR launch flow when it breaks, in the code review when a mapping rule is wrong, and in the room when the team needs a call made.

 

**What You'll Own**

 

**Architecture & Solution Design**

 

* **Own**

  the end-to-end architecture of the FHIR layer — SMART on FHIR launch and OAuth2, the canonical data model, the EMR adapter framework, tenant isolation, and event-driven orchestration — and keep it extensible to future EMRs (Epic, athenahealth) and formats (HL7v2, X12) beyond the Cerner pilot.
* **Make**

  build-vs-buy and vendor decisions (self-hosted HAPI FHIR vs. a managed FHIR store; Keycloak vs. a commercial identity provider; build vs. adopt an interface engine) and can defend the reasoning to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.
* **Design**

  the architecture against HIPAA-grade security and auditability requirements from day one — encryption, least-privilege access, audit trails — not as a pre-launch retrofit.
* **Validate**

  the architecture against real constraints: Oracle Health/Cerner's actual FHIR R4 conformance, US Core and Da Vinci PAS implementation guides, and the operational realities of a live, EHR-embedded launch — not just a reference diagram.

**Technical Leadership & Delivery**

 

* **Lead**

  a cross-functional engineering pod — full-stack engineers, AI/ML engineers, and QA engineers — setting technical direction, running code and design reviews, and removing blockers day to day.
* **Translate**

  the solution architecture into a sequenced, phased delivery plan (proof of concept → pilot → multi-client scale) and hold the team accountable to it.
* **Own**

  technical risk — surfacing integration blockers, vendor API gaps, and compliance findings early, and driving them to resolution rather than escalating and waiting.

**Integration, Standards & Compliance**

 

* **Lead**

  the Cerner/Oracle Health integration end to end: SMART App Launch (EHR launch, OAuth2/OIDC, fhirUser claims), Ignite APIs registration, and coordination with the client health system's Cerner administrators.
* **Define and enforce**

  conformance testing (ONC Inferno, US Core / Da Vinci PAS validation) before any integration is called production-ready.
* **Partner with**

  compliance and security stakeholders on HIPAA Security Risk Assessments, BAAs, and audit-trail requirements.

**Required Qualifications**

 

* 8+ years in healthcare interoperability or integration engineering, including 3+ years in an architect or technical lead capacity.
* Deep, hands-on FHIR R4 experience — resource modeling, RESTful FHIR APIs, and at least one implementation guide (US Core at minimum).
* Direct experience implementing SMART App Launch (EHR and/or standalone launch), OAuth2/OIDC, and at least one major EHR's FHIR API — Cerner/Oracle Health experience specifically preferred given Phase 1 scope.
* Hands-on experience with HAPI FHIR or an equivalent FHIR server — server customization and multi-tenant partitioning are a strong plus.
* Cloud architecture experience on AWS or equivalent: containers, managed relational databases, event-driven services (queues/event buses), and core identity/security services.
* Proven experience leading or managing engineers — running reviews, setting direction, and being accountable for a team's delivery, not only your own.
* Working knowledge of healthcare data exchange beyond FHIR — HL7v2, X12, CDA — sufficient to plan for future extensibility.
* Solid understanding of HIPAA technical safeguards and healthcare data compliance requirements.

**Strongly Preferred**

 

* Direct, hands-on experience with Oracle Health (Cerner) Millennium / Ignite APIs and PowerChart SMART app registration — or the Epic App Orchard equivalent.
* Experience with Keycloak or another open-source identity provider, including custom extension/SPI development.
* Familiarity with Da Vinci implementation guides (PAS, CRD, DTR) and FHIR-based prior authorization workflows.
* Experience in patient support programs, prior authorization, or healthcare CRM domains.
* Experience standing up a healthcare integration function from near-zero on a small team, not only operating within an already-mature enterprise integration group.
* Familiarity with applying AI/ML to healthcare data mapping, document generation, or clinical NLP — relevant given the AI engineers on this team.

**Tech Stack You'll Work With**

 

**Layer**

 

**Technologies**

 

**FHIR & integration standards**

 

FHIR R4, SMART App Launch v2, US Core, Da Vinci PAS, OAuth2 / OIDC, HL7v2 (future-facing) 

**FHIR server**

 

HAPI FHIR (JPA server), multi-tenant partitioning 

**Identity**

 

Keycloak, custom SMART-launch extension (SPI) 

**Cloud / infra**

 

AWS — Fargate/ECS, Aurora PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, API Gateway, WAF, EventBridge/SQS, Secrets Manager, KMS, CloudWatch/OpenSearch 

**IaC / delivery**

 

Terraform or AWS CDK, CI/CD (GitHub Actions or CodePipeline), Docker 

**Target EHR (Phase 1)**

 

Oracle Health / Cerner Millennium (Ignite APIs, PowerChart chart-toolbar launch) 

**Conformance testing**

 

ONC Inferno test kit (incl. Da Vinci PAS), Synthea synthetic data

description:
**Role:**

We are looking for an experienced
**Senior Data Governance**
with strong expertise in metadata management, enterprise data governance, semantic modeling and AI-enabled data architecture.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience with
**OpenMetadata, Collate or similar enterprise data governance platforms**
and the ability to design and implement scalable metadata and governance solutions.

The role involves building an AI-ready semantic metadata foundation that enables enterprise AI applications and agents through structured metadata, knowledge graphs, data contracts and governance frameworks.

Key Responsibilities

**Metadata Management & Data Governance**

* Design and implement enterprise metadata management and data governance solutions.
* Develop and maintain business glossaries, taxonomies and KPI/metric libraries.
* Establish metadata standards, governance policies and stewardship processes.
* Design and implement governance workflows and operating models.

**OpenMetadata / Collate Platform Implementation**

* Implement and manage metadata governance platforms such as OpenMetadata and Collate.
* Configure metadata ingestion, management and governance workflows.
* Integrate governance platforms with enterprise data ecosystems.
* Drive the evolution of metadata platforms to support AI-enabled governance.

**Semantic Modeling & Knowledge Graphs**

* Design and implement ontologies, semantic models and semantic views.
* Develop semantic metadata graphs and knowledge graph concepts.
* Establish metadata-driven context layers for AI applications and agents.
* Ensure consistent business definitions and relationships across enterprise data assets.

**Data Products & Data Contracts**

* Design and implement enterprise data products.
* Define data contracts at source, publishing and data product levels.
* Establish contract-based data quality validation and monitoring.
* Ensure data products meet defined quality and governance standards.

**Data Quality & Governance Frameworks**

* Design and implement data quality frameworks and validation processes.
* Establish governance controls, policies and guardrails.
* Implement monitoring and data stewardship processes.
* Ensure data governance practices are sustainable and scalable.

**AI Enablement & Enterprise Architecture**

* Build AI-ready metadata and governance architectures.
* Enable metadata-driven context for enterprise AI applications.
* Define governance guardrails to support responsible AI adoption.
* Align metadata management and governance capabilities with enterprise AI initiatives.

**Solution Architecture & Technical Leadership**

* Drive end-to-end solution architecture and implementation strategies.
* Conduct architecture, solution and governance reviews.
* Guide implementation teams on technical best practices.
* Define standards and scalable governance processes across enterprise platforms.

Required Technical Skills

* Strong experience with
  **OpenMetadata, Collate or similar data governance platforms**
  such as Collibra.
* Expertise in metadata management and enterprise data governance.
* Experience in business glossary, taxonomy and KPI/metric library design.
* Knowledge of ontologies, semantic modeling and knowledge graphs.
* Understanding of semantic metadata graphs and AI context-layer architecture.
* Experience in data product design and data contract implementation.
* Knowledge of data quality frameworks and governance workflows.
* Strong data engineering fundamentals and enterprise data integration concepts.
* Understanding of AI-ready data architecture and AI governance.

Required Functional Skills

* Strong enterprise solution architecture and solutioning capabilities.
* Ability to design governance operating models and workflows.
* Experience defining governance policies, standards and technical guardrails.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Ability to lead technical discussions and guide implementation teams.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

**The opportunity**
Join a Financial Crime Technology team delivering enterprise solutions for global financial services clients. The role requires strong hands-on engineering capability across NICE Actimize, Java, advanced SQL, and cloud platforms, supported by practical Financial Crime Compliance domain knowledge. The successful candidate will contribute to solution design, development, integration, deployment, optimization, and production support while guiding junior engineers and working directly with technical and business stakeholders.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer with proven experience implementing or supporting NICE Actimize solutions and building Java-based services and integrations. The role involves working with customer, account, transaction, alert, case, and screening data across KYC, AML, Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions, and Fraud use cases. Cloud and domain experience are mandatory. AI skills are an added advantage for accelerating engineering, analytics, documentation, testing, and investigation-support use cases.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, configure, develop, enhance, and support NICE Actimize solutions and related Financial Crime applications.
* Build and maintain Java applications, microservices, REST APIs, batch components, and integration services.
* Develop complex and optimized SQL for data ingestion, transformation, reconciliation, alerting, investigation, and reporting use cases.
* Integrate Actimize with upstream and downstream systems, including customer, account, transaction, case-management, screening, and reporting platforms.
* Deploy and support applications and data workloads on Azure, AWS, or GCP using appropriate cloud-native services.
* Translate compliance requirements into technical designs, rules, scenarios, data mappings, interfaces, and acceptance criteria.
* Perform performance tuning, defect analysis, root-cause analysis, code reviews, unit testing, release support, and production troubleshooting.
* Ensure secure coding, auditability, data protection, logging, monitoring, version control, and CI/CD practices.
* Collaborate with compliance SMEs, solution architects, data engineers, QA teams, infrastructure teams, and client stakeholders.
* Provide technical guidance to junior team members and take ownership of assigned modules and delivery outcomes.

**Mandatory Skills**

* Actimize: Strong hands-on experience with NICE Actimize implementation, configuration, customization, integration, enhancement, or production support. Experience should relate to Financial Crime solutions such as Transaction Monitoring, AML, sanctions screening, fraud, alerting, or case management.
* Java: Strong hands-on development experience with Core Java, object-oriented programming, collections, exception handling, multithreading fundamentals, Spring Boot, microservices, and REST APIs.
* Advanced SQL: Strong command of complex joins, subqueries, common table expressions, window functions, aggregations, stored procedures, query optimization, reconciliation, and high-volume data analysis.
* Cloud: Mandatory hands-on experience with at least one cloud platform: Microsoft Azure, AWS, or GCP. Experience must include developing, deploying, integrating, monitoring, or supporting applications and data workloads in a cloud environment.
* Financial Crime domain: Mandatory delivery experience in one or more of KYC, AML, Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions, or Fraud, with working knowledge of alerts, cases, investigations, rules or scenarios, regulatory controls, and financial crime data.
* Engineering practices: Git, Maven or Gradle, unit testing, code review, debugging, secure development, CI/CD, logging, monitoring, and production support.

**Actimize and Financial Crime knowledge**

* Actimize platform: Practical understanding of Actimize solution components, data flows, interfaces, alert generation, case workflows, rule or scenario changes, deployment, and operational support.
* Transaction Monitoring / AML: Scenario logic, thresholds, segmentation, alert generation, tuning support, false-positive analysis, investigations, and regulatory reporting concepts.
* KYC / CDD / EDD: Customer onboarding, identity checks, customer risk rating, beneficial ownership, periodic review, remediation, and enhanced due diligence.
* Sanctions: Customer and payment screening, watchlists, potential-match handling, disposition workflows, and screening data quality.
* Fraud: Fraud indicators, rules or models, event and transaction analysis, alert triage, investigations, and case outcomes.

**AI Skills – Added Advantage**

* Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot or equivalent for code generation, refactoring, testing, and documentation, with appropriate human review and secure-use practices.
* Understanding of generative AI and large language model concepts, including prompt design, retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, vector search, and API-based integration.
* Exposure to Python-based AI or machine-learning workflows, model evaluation, or analytics for anomaly detection, alert prioritization, investigation support, or false-positive reduction.
* Ability to identify responsible AI use cases while considering explainability, data privacy, security, model risk, auditability, and regulatory expectations.

**Good to have**

* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Kafka, or enterprise messaging and event-driven architecture.
* Knowledge of infrastructure as code and deployment tools such as Terraform, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or GitHub Actions.
* Experience with data platforms or processing tools such as Spark, Databricks, or cloud-native data services.
* Familiarity with observability tools, application performance monitoring, and structured production-support processes.
* Strong communication, estimation, technical documentation, stakeholder management, and Agile delivery skills.

**Experience And Education**

* Experience: Strictly 4+ years of relevant professional experience in software engineering, financial crime technology, Actimize delivery, application development, or production engineering.
* Eligibility: Candidates with less than 4 years of relevant professional experience will not be considered.
* Mandatory combination: Actimize, Java, SQL, cloud, and Financial Crime Compliance domain experience are all required.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Reliable Actimize enhancements and integrations delivered with production-quality Java and SQL.
* Clear understanding of the compliance objective, data lineage, operational controls, and regulatory context behind each solution.
* Ownership of design, development, testing, deployment, incident resolution, documentation, and stakeholder communication.

**What Working At EY Offers**

* You will work on meaningful Financial Crime Technology assignments in an interdisciplinary environment that values quality, practical learning, coaching, collaboration, technical ownership, and knowledge exchange. The role provides opportunities to deepen expertise across Actimize, modern Java engineering, cloud delivery, and responsible AI-enabled solutions.

title: BCM-API Integration-Banking Domain-Senior-GDSF02
description:

**BCM**
**Consulting – Banking & Capital Markets – API Integration**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
**Role Summary**
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced API Integration professional for Digital Banking and Banking Transformation initiatives. The role requires strong techno-functional expertise in banking APIs, integration platforms, middleware technologies, Open Banking frameworks and Core Banking Systems. The successful candidate will design, implement, test and support enterprise-wide API integration solutions connecting Core Banking, Digital Channels, Payment Systems, Fintech Ecosystems and third-party applications.
  
  
**Role: API Integration – Digital Banking Experience: 4 to 8 Years**
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Act as a Techno-Functional Consultant in Digital Banking and API Transformation projects.
* Analyze business requirements and translate them into scalable API and integration solutions.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, architects, product owners and development teams to define integration strategies.
* Design and document API specifications, service contracts, integration workflows and business process flows.
* Work closely with Core Banking, Digital Banking, Mobile Banking, Internet Banking, CRM, Payment Systems and external ecosystem integrations.
* Participate in API lifecycle management, including design, development, testing, deployment, monitoring and support.
* Identify integration opportunities and recommend best-fit architecture patterns.
* Support Open Banking initiatives in line with industry standards and regulatory requirements.
* Conduct client workshops, requirement-gathering sessions, solution walkthroughs and business demonstrations.
* Drive API integration testing, system integration testing (SIT), user acceptance testing (UAT) and production deployment activities.
* Troubleshoot integration and production issues and coordinate with cross-functional teams for resolution.
* Review technical designs, integration specifications and operational readiness documentation.
* Ensure adherence to enterprise security, governance, compliance and performance standards.

**Technical Skills**
**Skills and Attributes for Success**

* Strong experience in API design, development and integration.
* Experience with REST APIs, SOAP Web Services, GraphQL and event-driven integrations.
* Experience with API Gateway solutions, API management lifecycle and developer portal management.
* Experience with API security frameworks and knowledge of Open Banking standards and frameworks.
* Experience with integration platforms, enterprise service bus (ESB) solutions and messaging systems.
* Understanding of microservices architecture, containerization, Kubernetes, Docker and service mesh.
* Exposure to cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS and Google Cloud Platform.
* Understanding of CI/CD implementation and DevOps practices.
* Experience with relational and NoSQL databases.
* Experience with one or more technologies such as Java, Spring Boot and Node.js.
* Experience using Git, Bitbucket, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, Jira and Confluence.

**Functional And Consulting Skills**

* Strong knowledge of Banking Operations and the Digital Banking ecosystem.
* Ability to understand and document business requirements and conduct requirement analysis, gap analysis and impact assessment.
* Ability to define epics, features, user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Experience in business process mapping and process reengineering.
* Knowledge of customer onboarding, account servicing, payments, lending and the transaction lifecycle.
* Experience in Open Banking and Fintech integrations, with an understanding of API monetization and Banking-as-a-Service models.
* Ability to review integration test scenarios and ensure functional coverage.
* Experience conducting product demonstrations and stakeholder workshops.
* Excellent problem-solving, analytical, client-facing and consulting capabilities.
* Ability to work effectively in Agile and Scrum environments and coordinate across multiple vendor and stakeholder teams.

**Banking Domain Experience**
**Experience in one or more of the following areas:**

* Retail Banking; Corporate Banking; Digital Banking; Open Banking
* Lending and Loan Origination; Payments and Cards; Treasury Operations; Trade Finance
* Account Services; Customer Onboarding and KYC; Collections and Cash Management
* Wealth Management; Regulatory Reporting and Compliance
* API Banking and Banking-as-a-Service (BaaS)

**Ideally, You’ll Also**
Be a techno-functional integration professional who combines banking-domain knowledge, API delivery experience and consulting capability to connect business requirements with secure, scalable and supportable integration solutions.
  
  
**What We Look For**

* 4 to 8 years of relevant experience in API integration, Digital Banking or Banking Transformation initiatives.
* Hands-on experience across the API lifecycle, from design and documentation through testing, deployment, monitoring and support.
* Ability to work across Core Banking, digital channels, payment systems, Fintech ecosystems and third-party applications.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to work effectively in Agile and Scrum environments and coordinate across cross-functional, vendor and stakeholder teams.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment**
As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development**
From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits**
Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How To Apply**
If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.

description:

Packaged/SaaS Application Engineer
  
  
**Project Role Description :**
Configure and support packaged or SaaS applications to adapt features, manage releases, and ensure system stability. Use standard tools, APIs, and low-code platforms to align solutions with business needs while preserving compatibility and performance.
  
  
**Must have skills :**
Informatica ILM TDM and TDG
  
  
**Good to have skills :**
NA
  
  
**Minimum 5 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :**
15 years full time education
  
  
Summary:
  
  
As a Packaged or Software as a Service Application Engineer, a typical day involves configuring and supporting packaged or SaaS applications to meet evolving business requirements. This role includes managing application features, overseeing release processes, and ensuring the overall stability and performance of systems. The engineer works with various tools, application programming interfaces, and low-code platforms to tailor solutions that align with organizational goals while maintaining compatibility across different environments. Collaboration with multiple teams to address challenges and optimize application functionality is a key aspect of daily activities.
  
  
Roles & Responsibilities:
  
  

* Expected to be an SME, collaborate and manage the team to perform.
* Responsible for team decisions.
* Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions.
* Provide solutions to problems for their immediate team and across multiple teams.
* Lead efforts to identify and implement process improvements within the team to enhance efficiency and quality.
* Facilitate knowledge sharing and mentoring to support the growth and development of team members.
* Coordinate cross-functional communication to ensure alignment on project goals and deliverables.

Professional & Technical Skills:
  
  

* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Informatica ILM TDM and TDG.
* Strong understanding of data lifecycle management and test data management concepts.
* Experience in configuring and deploying data governance solutions within enterprise environments.
* Ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex issues related to data masking and data quality.
* Familiarity with integration of Informatica tools with other enterprise applications and platforms.

Additional Information:
  
  

* The candidate should have minimum 5 years of experience in Informatica ILM TDM and TDG.
* This position is based at our Coimbatore office.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

title: Amazon Growth Engineer
description:
**About the role**

This is a graduate program for engineers with AI/ML, data or systems skills. We will train you on Amazon, then hand you the full growth engine for million-dollar brands on Amazon India and the US.

You do not need any Amazon or e-commerce experience. We need front-runners who think in data and systems, and look for evidence before they act, and we will teach you the marketplace.

Most Amazon roles split listings, ads and inventory across three people who rarely talk. This role joins them. You will plan the sales number, build the listings and ads that deliver it, make sure stock is there to sell, and explain every gap between plan and actual.

You will work inside ProfitStory's in-house AI platform (Moneyball), with a Postgres data warehouse and agentic tools for advertising and seller analytics. ProfitStory manages around $60M in client GMV and is part of NVIDIA Inception. Your engineering skills are the advantage here: you will build the models, automations and guardrails that let you manage brands at a scale no manual team can match.

**What you'll own**

We cross-train you across seven areas, one at a time. Within your first year you own all seven for your brands, with one outcome: the brand hits its sales plan profitably, with no surprises.

**1. Listings - SEO and AEO**

* Write and optimise titles, bullets, descriptions, A+ content and backend keywords using AI tools, grounded in Brand Analytics and search query data.
* Optimise for answer engines too (AEO): Amazon Rufus, and AI shopping answers on ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google. Structure content so these engines can find, understand and recommend the product.
* Track indexing, keyword rank and conversion rate after every change.

**2. Inventory planning**

* Build replenishment plans in SQL and AI tools: sell-through, days of cover, lead times, MOQ and FBA capacity limits.
* Plan inbound shipments to avoid stock-outs and excess or aged inventory, ahead of sales events.

**3. PPC - plan and execute**

* Build and run Sponsored Products, Brands and Display campaigns end to end: structure, keywords, bids, budgets and negatives.
* Manage ACoS, TACoS and ROAS targets set against the brand's profit goals, not just spend.

**4. Evidence, guardrails and validation**

* Set the rules every change must pass before it goes live: bid and budget caps, price floors, listing edits, reorder quantities.
* Validate every AI recommendation before it is executed: it must cite the data behind it, and that evidence must hold up when you check it. After execution, measure the outcome against what was expected. Catch anomalies in spend, price, Buy Box and stock early.

**5. Automation**

* Turn repeated work into scripts, SQL jobs, alerts and AI agents: reports, bid rules, stock alerts, listing checks.
* Document each automation so the team can run and trust it.

**6. Forecasting and the sales plan**

* Forecast monthly sales by ASIN from history, seasonality, events (Prime Day, Great Indian Festival, BFCM) and planned ad spend.
* Turn the forecast into a plan the brand signs off: revenue, units, ad spend and inventory needed.

**7. Deviation analysis**

* Every week, compare actual against plan and find the cause: traffic, conversion, price, ad spend, stock-outs, Buy Box loss or competitors.
* Present the fix and the revised plan to the client in clear, simple language.

**What you bring**

The critical skill is analytics. You find patterns, correlations and causes in data, and you separate signal from noise. When AI recommends an action, you check its citations, test it against the evidence, decide if it is safe to execute, and measure the result afterwards.

* B.E. / B.Tech / M.Tech in any branch, 2027 final-year students, with a strong foundation in one of:

-
**AI/ML:**
Model building, LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG or agents.

-
**Data:**
SQL, statistics, data analysis, time-series or forecasting.

-
**Systems:**
Python, APIs, automation, backend or data pipelines.

* Working SQL and Python. You can query a dataset and explain what it says.
* Hands-on use of AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini or similar) in projects or daily work. Show us what you built.
* A project, internship or GitHub repo that shows how you solve problems with data or code.
* Curiosity about business: how products are sold, priced and found by customers.
* Clear communication in English. You can explain a number to a non-technical person.
* Willingness to learn fast, take ownership, and work extra hours during peak sales events.

No Amazon or e-commerce experience needed. We teach that.

**Nice to have**

* Kaggle, hackathon or competition work in ML, forecasting or analytics.
* Experience with any REST API, or with building an AI agent or chatbot.
* Familiarity with Excel or Google Sheets for quick analysis.
* Exposure to BI tools such as Metabase, Looker Studio or Power BI.
* Your own experience selling online, on any platform.

**Why join**

* Use your AI and data skills on real money from day one: million-dollar brands on Amazon India and the US.
* Learn a rare mix: engineering plus marketplace business, which few graduates have.

title: Senior Onboarding & Implementation Specialist
description:
**RunLoyal · Full-time · Coimbatore, India**

**Work Shift: US Working Hours — Mandatory**

**Experience: 4-6 years**

**About RunLoyal**

Do you care about the businesses that care for pets every day — and want to build software that helps them operate better?

Do you enjoy breaking complex systems, finding problems before customers do, and building automation that makes engineering teams faster and more confident?

If your answer is yes, RunLoyal could be the place for you.
  

RunLoyal is a fast-growing vertical SaaS technology company building modern software for the pet care industry. Boarding facilities, daycare centers, groomers, trainers and dog parks use our platform to run their businesses and give pet parents a better experience. We headquartered in Atlanta, GA.

An all-in-one platform: business management, a custom branded app for every customer, staff tools, payments, communications, reporting and Scout AI. Pets make it approachable. The software is the craft.

Our platform powers the day-to-day operations of pet-care businesses across boarding, daycare, grooming, training, memberships, payments, customer engagement, reporting, and facility operations.

As RunLoyal continues to scale its platform, customer base, and engineering organization, we are looking for a Full Stack Engineer who wants more than a traditional development role.

This is an opportunity to work on a real SaaS product, solve meaningful customer and engineering problems, and take ownership of features from idea to production.

You will work closely with Product, Engineering, QA, and other teams to understand the problem behind a requirement, contribute to technical decisions, build scalable solutions, validate them thoroughly, and support what you ship.

If you enjoy working in a growing product company where engineers are expected to think, build, improve, and own, this role is for you.

**What You'll Own**
**Customer Discovery & Solution Design**

* Become the customer's primary implementation contact after the Sales handoff.
* Lead structured discovery sessions with business owners and operational stakeholders.
* Understand customer workflows, services, pricing, memberships, packages, staffing, booking rules, payments, agreements, notifications, reporting, and operational requirements.
* Identify unclear, conflicting, or incomplete requirements before implementation begins.
* Translate business needs into the correct RunLoyal configuration.
* Recommend practical workflows and explain product limitations or alternatives when required.
* Escalate genuine product gaps to Product or Engineering with clear business context.

**Product Configuration & Data Migration**

* Configure customer environments based on approved requirements.
* Set up services, pricing, memberships, packages, staff access, booking workflows, policies, payments, and related settings.
* Work with customer data from Excel, Google Sheets, CSV files, and structured exports.
* Clean, normalize, transform, and map data into required import formats.
* Identify duplicate, incomplete, malformed, or inconsistent records.
* Validate imported customer, pet, membership, package, service, and other operational data.
* Complete post-import reconciliation and escalate discrepancies before go-live.

**Implementation QA, Training & Go-Live**

* Validate configured environments against approved customer requirements.
* Test realistic workflows covering booking, pricing, payments, memberships, staff access, services, and customer records.
* Identify configuration or data issues before they reach the customer.
* Conduct administrator and staff training.
* Explain workflows clearly to technical and non-technical users.
* Confirm readiness across configuration, data, users, payments, training, and operational processes.
* Drive customers through go-live and provide support during the initial launch period.
* Complete a structured handoff to Customer Success or Support after stabilization.

**Technical Troubleshooting**

You do not need to be a software engineer, but you should be comfortable investigating before escalating.

You will:

* Troubleshoot configuration and data issues independently.
* Use browser developer tools where helpful.
* Use SQL for data verification and investigation.
* Distinguish between configuration issues, data problems, integration behavior, product defects, and enhancement requests.
* Provide Engineering and QA with clear and reproducible issue details.

**Senior-Level Ownership**

* Manage complex, multi-location, or high-value implementations.
* Handle multiple onboarding projects concurrently.
* Identify implementation risks early and create mitigation plans.
* Act as an escalation point for complex onboarding issues.
* Review configuration and migration work completed by junior team members.
* Coach team members on discovery, data quality, solution mapping, and customer communication.
* Help improve RunLoyal's implementation standards, templates, documentation, and processes.

**What We're Looking For**
**Experience**

* **4–6 years of relevant professional experience**

  in SaaS implementation, customer onboarding, implementation consulting, solution consulting, business analysis, technical account management, or a related customer-facing role.
* At least
  **2–3 years of direct ownership of US based B2B SaaS implementations or similarly complex customer projects**

  .
* Independently managing customer onboarding via phone, customer training, and demos is a non-negotiable.
* Experience leading customers from discovery through configuration, migration, training, and go-live.
* Experience working directly with business owners, operational leaders, or senior stakeholders.
* Experience managing multiple implementation projects simultaneously.

**Core Requirements**

* Strong customer discovery and requirements-gathering skills.
* Ability to translate business workflows into software configuration.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent attention to detail and a strong implementation QA mindset.
* Advanced working knowledge of
  **Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets**

  .
* Experience with CSV-based data cleaning, mapping, transformation, and validation.
* Strong written and verbal English communication.
* Confidence leading customer meetings independently.
* Strong organizational and project-management skills.
* Ability to identify risks, manage dependencies, and communicate blockers clearly.
* Ability to work independently with limited supervision.
* Comfortable working
  **mandatory US business hours from Coimbatore**

  .
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Technology, Business, Computer Applications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Technical Skills**

The ideal candidate should have working knowledge of:

* Excel / Google Sheets
* CSV data handling and transformation
* SQL fundamentals
* Webhooks and integrations
* SaaS configuration concepts
* Browser-based troubleshooting
* Data validation and reconciliation
* CRM and project-management tools

You are not expected to code production software, but you should be technically confident enough to investigate problems before escalating them.

**Preferred Qualifications**

Experience in any of the following will be an advantage:

* US based B2B or vertical SaaS implementation.
* Multi-location or operational software.
* Customer data migrations.
* SQL-based validation or troubleshooting.
* API-based integrations.
* Payments or transactional systems.
* HubSpot, Jira, Asana, Notion, Monday.com, Intercom, Salesforce, or similar platforms.
* Mentoring junior implementation or onboarding specialists.
* Startup or scale-up environments.
* Pet-care, hospitality, scheduling, POS, healthcare, field-service, or appointment-based businesses.

You do not need experience with every tool listed above. Strong ownership, learning ability, customer judgment, and SaaS implementation experience matter most.

**Good to have**

* REST APIs
* JSON
* Relational database concepts
* Understanding of REST APIs, JSON, integrations, and webhooks at a functional level.

**What We'll Evaluate**

We will assess your ability to:

* Discover how a customer's business actually operates.
* Translate requirements into the right SaaS configuration.
* Own implementations from Sales handoff through go-live.
* Work carefully with customer data and prevent avoidable migration errors.
* Lead customer conversations and manage expectations professionally.
* Investigate technical issues before escalating.
* Manage multiple projects without losing track of decisions, risks, deadlines, or dependencies.
* Demonstrate senior-level judgment and ownership.

**Key Success Measures**

Success in this role will be measured through:

1. **Time to Go-Live**

   — Customers launched within agreed timelines.
2. **Implementation Accuracy**

   — Low configuration and migration errors after launch.
3. **Customer Onboarding CSAT**

   — Satisfaction with communication, implementation, and training.
4. **Go-Live Readiness**

   — Successful completion of configuration, migration, validation, and training.
5. **Early Customer Adoption**

   — Customers actively using agreed RunLoyal workflows after launch.

Additional measures may include migration accuracy, escalation quality, documentation completeness, handoff quality, and implementation backlog.

**Why Join RunLoyal?**

* Own customer implementations from kickoff through successful launch.
* Work directly with US business owners and operational leaders.
* Build expertise across a complex SaaS platform spanning scheduling, payments, memberships, customer operations, reporting, and integrations.
* Work closely with Product, Engineering, QA, Customer Success, and Support.
* Help shape RunLoyal's implementation processes as the company grows.
* Build a career toward roles such as Implementation Lead, Solutions Consultant, Solutions Architect, Implementation Manager, Technical Account Management, or Customer Success Leadership.

**Our Values**

**Kindness**

**Trust**

**Fearlessness**

**Discourse, Not Dissonance**

**Understanding, Not Consensus**

**Ownership**

**Curiosity**

**Ready to Own the Customer Journey?**

If you enjoy
**understanding businesses, solving complex problems, working directly with customers, managing meaningful SaaS implementations, and growing with a fast-moving product company**

, we would love to hear from you.

And yes—a genuine love for pets is always a plus. 🐾

title: Data Tech Lead
description:
Orion Innovation is a premier, award-winning, global business and technology services firm. Orion delivers game-changing business transformation and product development rooted in digital strategy, experience design, and engineering, with a unique combination of agility, scale, and maturity. We work with a wide range of clients across many industries including financial services, professional services, telecommunications and media, consumer products, automotive, industrial automation, professional sports and entertainment, life sciences, ecommerce, and education.
  
  
**Job Overview:**

* We are seeking a Technical Lead - Data & Analytics to lead the design and delivery of enterprise-grade capabilities across enterprise data and analytics initiatives. The role requires strong grounding in data concepts, modern data engineering and analytics, metadata and governance, semantic and ontology-driven solutions, and cloud-native delivery practices. The successful candidate will provide technical direction, guide engineering teams, own design quality, and contribute directly to implementation.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Technical Leadership: Lead solution design and delivery across Data & Analytics workstreams; translate business requirements into scalable technical designs; conduct design and code reviews; define engineering standards; mentor developers and data engineers; manage technical risks and dependencies.
* Data & Analytics Capabilities: Drive implementation across data ingestion, extraction, profiling, standardization, cataloguing, metadata, lineage, data quality, governance, security, compliance, ontology and entity discovery, knowledge graph, unified query, self-service insights, metrics, monitoring and platform observability.
* Data Architecture & Engineering: Design solutions for structured, semi-structured and unstructured data; define conceptual, logical and physical models; establish ETL/ELT patterns; support lake, Lakehouse and warehouse architecture; ensure performance, scalability, reliability and maintainability.
* Cloud & Platform Engineering: Design and deploy cloud-native solutions on Azure, AWS or GCP; select fit-for-purpose managed services; apply security, networking, identity, resilience, cost and operational best practices.
* DevOps & Containerization: Establish source control, branching, automated build, test and release pipelines; package services and agents using Docker; deploy and operate workloads on Kubernetes; enable configuration, secrets, monitoring, logging and rollback practices.
* Agentic AI Enablement: Contribute to agentic and generative AI solutions, including agent orchestration, tool integration, retrieval-augmented generation, semantic and vector search, knowledge graphs, prompt and response controls, evaluation, guardrails and observability.
* Snowflake Delivery: Design and optimize Snowflake solutions covering ingestion, transformation, modelling, security, governance, data sharing, performance and cost management; integrate Snowflake with cloud, analytics and AI services.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with architects, product owners, business SMEs, governance teams and delivery leads; communicate designs clearly; support estimates, planning, demonstrations, production readiness and issue resolution.

**Key Skills:**

* 7-10+ years of overall experience, primarily in Data & Analytics, with experience leading technical delivery teams or workstreams.
* Strong understanding of data modelling, data warehousing, Lakehouse architecture, ETL/ELT, data pipelines, data quality, metadata, lineage, governance, master/reference data and analytics consumption patterns.
* Hands-on experience designing and building enterprise-scale data solutions using Python, SQL and relevant data engineering frameworks.
* Experience with at least one major cloud platform: Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS) or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Practical experience with Git-based development, continuous integration and delivery, automated testing, release automation and environment promotion.
* Hands-on exposure to Docker and Kubernetes-based deployment, including configuration, secrets, scaling, monitoring and troubleshooting.
* Working exposure to Agentic AI, Generative AI, LLM-based applications, RAG, vector search, knowledge graphs or multi-agent workflows.
* Experience with Snowflake architecture and development, including data pipelines, security, governance and performance optimization.
* Ability to independently own technical design, guide engineers, review implementation quality and resolve complex delivery issues.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical decisions to both engineering and business stakeholders.

**Preferred Experience:**

* Experience with Databricks, Microsoft Fabric or equivalent modern data and AI platforms.
* Exposure to business glossaries, semantic models, ontologies, entity resolution and enterprise knowledge graphs.
* Experience with orchestration or agent frameworks such as Lang Graph, Lang Chain, Semantic Kernel or similar technologies.
* Understanding of vector databases, model serving, prompt engineering, AI evaluation and responsible AI controls.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code and platform automation using Terraform, Bicep, CloudFormation or equivalent tools.
* Prior experience delivering metadata-driven, governance-led, self-service or AI-enabled data platforms.

Orion is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, citizenship status, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Platform management | System Migration | Platform implementation | Integration management | Data Analytics | Learning management System | Learning Agility | Solution centricity | Ability to work under pressure | Teamwork
  
  
**What You Will Be Responsible For**

* Execute learning and talent technology strategy. At the direction of the Learning Tech & Curation Lead work to establish the enterprise-wide approach to learning and talent technology platform management. This strategy works with learning platforms such as learning management system (LMS) as primary requirement and supporting learning experience platform (LXP). This involved optimal LMS implementation set-up, migration management, integration with content providers and other platforms in learning, video communication (WebEx/Zoom) and talent platforms.

* Support the administration of learning and talent technologies. Support day-to-day ongoing operations activities including maintenance, usage, analysis, reporting, L3, integration and administration of the learning technologies.
* Curation mindset. Exposure to optimize learning assets across the organization
* Participate in establishing structure, governance, and context to manage platforms.
* Manage the learner experience with technology. Support the required infrastructure, tools, and integrations to promote a technology-enabled learning culture.
* Partner with internal stakeholders, curation manager, technology teams and external information to offer customized and vetted selection of the most effective and relevant resources.

* Degree level qualification or relevant professional qualification
* Broad experience in the Learning and talent technology space, preferable (not compulsory) in financial institutions.
* High learning agility (ability & curiosity to learn new skills, new technology and changing dynamics of the work objectives) is a required skill.
* Have worked with LMS (preferably but not limited to CSOD) at the level of configuration, release management, user and access management as solution management perspective (and not just administration management) – Similar experience in LXP (like Degreed, Edcast etc.) is preferable but not compulsory.

* Excellent data management analysis using MS Excel. Exposure to any other data analysis tool is a plus but not compulsory
* Strong project management skills, ability to execute project plans on a regional and global scale. Tactical planning experience with excellent interpersonal skills
* This role requires a high caliber learning technology professional with broad learning technology platform management experience. A positive can-do attitude and ability to navigate ambiguity will be key success factors.
* Ability to apply and leverage technology while working across regions and functions are critical elements of the role. Understanding of learning & talent assets curation and optimization is required plus.
* Authenticity, Empathy and being a very strong team player with collaborative solution-centric mind-set is non-negotiable requirement of this role.

**Job Title: Manager – Data Operations**
**Summary:**
We are looking for a skilled and experienced Manager – Data Operations to manage the day-to-day operation of enterprise data pipelines and platforms supporting corporate finance transformation.
  
  
This role combines hands-on operational oversight, service management, and team leadership to ensure timely, accurate, and reliable data delivery. The ideal candidate will work closely with data engineering, platform, governance, and business teams to support finance processes across P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A.
  
  
You will be accountable for operational performance, incident coordination, data quality monitoring, and continuous improvement within the assigned service scope, helping business users and clients access trusted data within agreed service levels.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**
**Data Operations & Technical Oversight**

* Manage daily operation of batch and streaming data pipelines, including ingestion, transformation, scheduling, and delivery to downstream systems and reporting platforms.
* Monitor job execution, data freshness, processing volumes, and dependencies; coordinate reruns, backfills, and recovery using approved procedures and reconciliation checks.
* Maintain operational runbooks, standard operating procedures, job inventories, dependency maps, and escalation paths for supported data services.
* Investigate pipeline failures, data discrepancies, and performance issues using logs, monitoring tools, and SQL; engage engineering teams where code or architecture changes are required.
* Coordinate production changes and releases with engineering and DevOps teams, validating operational readiness, support handover, rollback procedures, and post-release checks.
* Lead incident triage, business-impact assessment, escalation, and service restoration; coordinate root-cause analysis and track corrective actions to closure.

**Service Delivery & Operational Excellence**

* Plan and prioritize operational workloads, support requests, and improvement activities to meet agreed SLAs and critical business processing deadlines.
* Implement incident, problem, change, and service request management practices; maintain effective shift handovers and on-call coverage where required by the service model.
* Track and report pipeline success rates, data freshness, SLA adherence, incident volumes, recovery times, and recurring failures; use trends to improve service performance.
* Automate repetitive checks, recovery steps, and reporting where appropriate; work with engineering teams to reduce manual effort, recurring incidents, and inefficient resource usage.
* Operate data quality checks and source-to-target reconciliations; route exceptions to accountable data owners and maintain evidence of resolution, access reviews, and approved controls.

**Team Leadership & Talent Management**

* Manage a team of data operations analysts and support engineers, assigning responsibilities and ensuring appropriate coverage for supported services.
* Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, service ownership, and disciplined execution, with clear expectations for operational quality.
* Manage capacity planning, onboarding, performance feedback, and training; develop cross-skilling and backup coverage for critical processes.
* Coach team members on troubleshooting, data validation, incident handling, documentation, and stakeholder communication.

**Business & Stakeholder Management**

* Partner with finance stakeholders, data owners, and reporting teams to understand data dependencies, business priorities, and critical reporting or period-close schedules.
* Coordinate with data engineering, platform, security, and governance teams to resolve operational issues and maintain clear ownership across service boundaries.
* Support onboarding of new data services by validating support requirements, monitoring coverage, runbooks, knowledge transfer, and acceptance criteria.
* Communicate service status, incidents, business impact, recovery estimates, and improvement progress clearly to stakeholders and management.

**Data Quality & Continuous Improvement**

* Work with data owners to define and maintain operational checks for completeness, accuracy, validity, consistency, and timeliness of critical datasets.
* Identify recurring data and process issues; maintain a prioritized improvement backlog and standardize reusable monitoring, reconciliation, and support practices.
* Support backup and recovery validation, continuity exercises, and retention procedures with platform and governance teams; verify data integrity following restoration.

**Qualifications**
**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 7+ years of experience in data operations, data engineering support, production support, or analytics operations, including responsibility for enterprise data services.
* 2+ years of team leadership or people-management experience, with a track record of coordinating operational delivery and developing support teams.

**Technical Expertise**

* Hands-on experience supporting data workloads on at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP), including monitoring, troubleshooting, and access controls.
* Strong SQL skills and understanding of ETL/ELT processes, relational databases, data warehouses, and data lake or lakehouse environments.
* Experience with data orchestration and processing tools relevant to the environment (e.g., Airflow, Azure Data Factory, Spark, dbt, or Kafka), including failure diagnosis and recovery.
* Working knowledge of Python or shell scripting, APIs, file-based integrations, logging, and monitoring tools to automate checks and investigate data flow issues.
* Understanding of data quality, reconciliation, lineage, role-based access, sensitive-data handling, and enterprise governance requirements.

**Operational & Delivery Skills**

* Proven ability to manage production data services against SLAs, prioritize incidents by business impact, and coordinate effective service restoration.
* Experience with incident, problem, and change management, release support, runbooks, and root-cause analysis; familiarity with ITIL, DevOps, or DataOps practices.
* Ability to interpret operational metrics, identify performance and capacity issues, and coordinate improvements with engineering and platform teams.

**Domain & Functional Knowledge**

* Exposure to corporate finance processes (P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A), finance data flows, and the importance of timely and accurate reporting is preferred.
* Experience supporting finance transformation, ERP-connected data pipelines, analytics platforms, or period-end reporting operations is highly desirable.

**Leadership & Behavioral Skills**

* Strong team supervision, workload planning, coaching, and collaboration skills.
* Clear stakeholder communication, including the ability to explain incidents, business impact, and resolution progress to non-technical audiences.
* Ability to remain organized under pressure, apply structured problem-solving, and balance hands-on troubleshooting with effective delegation.
* High ownership mindset focused on data reliability, service quality, timely escalation, and continuous improvement.

title: Salesforce Administrator
description:
**About MAXVAL:**

MaxVal started as an IP services company in 2004, with a keen focus on efficiency, cost-effectiveness, and continuous improvement through metrics-based processes. Our focus on these core values led to the tech-enablement of our offerings even before this buzzword became an industry standard. Over the years, MaxVal developed many internal applications to increase our quality and efficiency, and customer satisfaction. As these systems grew and became more sophisticated, we have productized them and offered them to our clients. Today, MaxVal serves over 600 clients across the full IP life cycle with the industry’s leading products and services. Our 700 plus employees represent the most IP and tech-savvy individuals in the industry." At MaxVal, we do the right things and innovate ceaselessly as a winning team to achieve customer success and employee success.

**Job Summary:**

We are seeking a Salesforce Administrator to serve as the primary system administrator for our Salesforce.com environment. In this role, you will be responsible for handling administrative functions, system audits, data integrations, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to define and document requirements. You will play a key role in ensuring the smooth operation of Salesforce, supporting development and change management activities, and assisting in user training to foster skill growth across the organization.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Serve as the primary system administrator for the Salesforce.com environment.
* Handle basic administrative functions including user account maintenance, reports, dashboards, workflows, and other routine tasks.
* Complete regular internal system audits and prepare for Salesforce upgrades.
* Manage Salesforce.com data feeds and integrations with other systems.
* Coordinate the evaluation, scope, and completion of new development requests.
* Collaborate with the institutional management team to establish processes supporting administrative, development, and change management activities.
* Assist in training new users and help grow the Salesforce skill set within the team/organization.
* Act as a liaison between users, vendors, and application development teams.
* Work independently with team members to define and document development requirements.

**Skills Required:**

* Demonstrated ability to meet deadlines, handle and prioritize simultaneous requests, and manage tasks across different levels of the organization.
* Creative and analytical thinker with strong problem-solving skills.
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to communicate effectively at all organizational levels.
* Ability to assess the impact of new requirements on Salesforce.com and upstream/downstream applications, systems, and processes.

**Experience Required:**

* Minimum of 2 years of experience as a Salesforce.com administrator.
* Salesforce.com Admin (ADM201 and ADM211) certified (preferred).
* Salesforce certifications in Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Developer (preferred).
* Proven ability to design and implement new processes and facilitate user adoption.
* Strong understanding of Salesforce platform capabilities, including building custom apps, objects, formula fields, workflows, custom views, and other content of intermediate complexity.
* Strong understanding of Salesforce best practices and functionality.
* Strong data management abilities.
* A documented history of successfully driving projects to completion.
* Demonstrated ability to understand and articulate complex requirements.
* Previous experience working in a SCRUM or agile environment (preferred).

**Additional Information:**

* Shift timings: 11:30 AM - 8:30 PM or 8:30 PM - 5:30 AM.

**Website Link:**
https://www.maxval.com/

title: Senior AI Solutions Architect
description:
**Job Description:**

We are looking for a
**“Senior Solution Architect”**

with strong hands-on coding expertise and experience designing and developing scalable, secure, and high-performance applications using modern technologies.

The ideal candidate should have a solid software engineering background, expertise in cloud-native architectures, and practical experience building and deploying AI agents and LLM-powered applications. This role requires a hands-on technical leader who can drive architecture decisions while actively contributing to development and implementation.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Design and implement scalable, secure, and high-performance software architectures aligned with business requirements.
* Develop production-grade applications, APIs, microservices, and distributed systems using modern programming languages and frameworks.
* Build and integrate AI agents, agentic workflows, and LLM-powered solutions into enterprise applications.
* Implement AI capabilities such as tool calling, RAG, workflow orchestration, and integration with enterprise systems.
* Evaluate and adopt emerging technologies, AI frameworks, and architectural patterns.
* Lead technical design discussions, conduct code reviews, and establish engineering standards and best practices.
* Collaborate with product managers, stakeholders, and engineering teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
* Optimize application performance, scalability, reliability, and security.
* Implement CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, monitoring, and DevOps practices.
* Mentor developers and provide technical guidance throughout the software development lifecycle.

**Required Technical Skills:**

**1. Software Development**

* Strong hands-on coding experience in one or more languages: Python, Java, C#, JavaScript, or TypeScript.
* Excellent understanding of data structures, algorithms, object-oriented programming, and design patterns.
* Experience developing, debugging, and optimizing production-grade applications.

**2. Solution Architecture**

* Expertise in microservices, distributed systems, event-driven architecture, and RESTful APIs.
* Experience designing scalable, highly available, and secure enterprise applications.
* Knowledge of domain-driven design, system integration, and architectural documentation.

**3. AI Agents & Generative AI**

* Hands-on experience developing and deploying AI agents for real-world applications.
* Strong understanding of LLMs, prompt engineering, tool calling, and agent orchestration.
* Experience with frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent.
* Knowledge of RAG, embeddings, vector databases, and enterprise data integration.
* Understanding of AI agent evaluation, guardrails, security, and performance optimization.
* Experience integrating LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, or Google Gemini.

**4. Cloud & DevOps**

* Experience with AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code.
* Familiarity with automated testing, logging, monitoring, and deployment practices.

**5. Databases & Integration**

* Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases such as PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, or Redis.
* Knowledge of third-party API integrations and enterprise system connectivity.
* Familiarity with Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar messaging technologies is an advantage.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 10+ years of software development experience, including significant experience in solution architecture or technical leadership.
* Proven track record of delivering production-ready applications using modern technology stacks.
* Experience deploying and maintaining AI agent solutions in production environments.
* Strong communication, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.

**Key Requirement: Strong hands-on coding skills and practical experience developing AI agents are essential. Candidates with architecture-only experience and limited coding exposure will not be suitable.**

title: IT Infrastructure System Engineer - Windows
description:
Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins works with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate. Eurofins believes it is a global leader in food, environmental, pharmaceutical and cosmetics products testing and in agroscience CRO services. It is also one of the global independent market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, discovery pharmacology, forensics, CDMO, advanced material sciences and in the support of clinical studies.

In over just 30 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 62,000 staff across a network of more than 1000 independent companies in over 62 countries and operating more than 900 laboratories. Eurofins offers a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products, as well as providing innovative clinical diagnostic testing services, as one of the leading global emerging players in specialised clinical diagnostics testing.

In 2022, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR € 6.515 billion, and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.

**Job Description**

Position Title: L3 Operations Senior Compute Engineer
  
  
Reporting To: Compute Service Operations Lead, Environment Testing Europe
  
  
Working Location: Coimbatore
  
  
Shift Timing: 12PM – 9PM IST
  
  
  
  
  
  
OVERALL OBJECTIVES:

As part of the IT Infrastructure Support Team for Eurofins Environment Testing Europe, you will join a growing international team to work on maintenance of newly deployed segregated IT User Zones and Application Availability Groups Cloud infrastructure. Your role will be to support daily Compute operations tasks in a complex hybrid environment in Azure Cloud and local HyperV infrastructure. You will collaborate with number of different IT Support and Delivery Teams on daily basis. It will require strong Azure & HyperV virtualization, AD, Security and Networking skills. Open mind and ability to cooperate with multiple individuals in a multicultural environment is essential.
  
  
  
  
You will get an opportunity to drive Eurofins major IT Infrastructure transition and transformation across Environment Testing Europe Businesses.
  
  
  
  
SPECIFIC ASSIGNMENTS:
  
  
  
  
  
  
Manage, maintain and optimize Azure compute services as well as on-premises Hyper-V clusters and virtual machine infrastructure
  
  
Implement automation and orchestration for deployment, scaling, and management using PowerShell
  
  
Monitor compute infrastructure health, troubleshoot incidents, and execute root cause analysis to prevent recurrence
  
  
Collaborate with cloud architects, network, and security teams, as well as application owners at the international corporate level to support compute capacity planning and optimization and best meet business requirements in terms of security, cost, and effectiveness
  
  
Enforce security best practices and compliance requirements in cloud and on-prem environments
  
  
Develop and maintain infrastructure-as-code for both Azure and Hyper-V platforms
  
  
Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and knowledge sharing within the compute operations team
  
  
Maintain detailed documentation of operational procedures, configurations, and workflows
  
  
Stay current with environment version updates, emerging technologies, and industry best practices
  
  
  
  
  
  
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:
  
  
  
  
An ideal candidate should have strong experience in all of the below:
  
  
  
  
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  
  
5+ years managing compute infrastructure with strong focus on Microsoft technologies.
  
  
Deep expertise in managing Hyper-V environments including failover clustering, live migration, and storage management.
  
  
Solid understanding of Windows Server administration and networking fundamentals.
  
  
Experience in administering and maintaining print server environments, as well as troubleshooting printing‑related issues in Windows environments.
  
  
Experience with backup and disaster recovery strategies for both cloud and on-premises environments (preferably in Veeam backup environments).
  
  
Excellent troubleshooting, communication, and collaboration skills
  
  
Ability to read, understand and create technical documentation
  
  
Very good command of English written and spoken
  
  
Ability to present technical projects on meetings
  
  
Proven experience with Microsoft Azure compute services
  
  
Scripting skills in PowerShell; experience with Azure CLI and ARM templates is highly preferred.
  
  
  
  
WOULD BE AN ADVANTAGE
  
  
  
  
Experience in administering Linux server environments
  
  
Accustomed to using ITSM tools (e.g. BMC Helix)
  
  
Experience of monitoring tools (Site24x7, Grafana, etc.)
  
  
Familiarity with Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and other Azure-native monitoring tools
  
  
Experience with Azure DevOps or other CI/CD pipelines

Techjays is an AI engineering and technology consulting firm headquartered in Menlo Park, California, with delivery teams in Coimbatore and Chennai, India.

We are setting up a managed operations team in India to support a US-based B2B SaaS CRM platform. The platform runs on physical servers in a colocation data center rather than on a public cloud such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.

You will keep databases available, backed up, and performing efficiently; troubleshoot performance issues; and plan upgrades and high availability/disaster recovery (HA/DR) changes. You will also review and deploy database changes associated with application releases.

You will work closely with the Infrastructure and Platform Operations Manager, the Infrastructure Security and Release Operations Lead, and the client's engineering team on schema and query changes.

**Key Responsibilities**

·   Administer production and non-production SQL Server instances, including installation, configuration, patching, and version upgrades.

·   Run and test backups and restores, ensuring recovery point and recovery time objectives are met.

·   Manage high availability and disaster recovery using Always On Availability Groups, failover clustering, or log shipping, and conduct failover tests.

·   Monitor database health, identify slow queries, blocking, and deadlocks, and tune queries and indexes.

·   Plan and perform index maintenance, statistics updates, and database integrity checks (DBCC) while minimizing customer impact.

·   Review and deploy schema changes and data scripts as part of releases, with rollback steps prepared in advance.

·   Manage logins, roles, permissions, encryption, and auditing in line with security and compliance requirements.

·   Track storage growth and plan capacity as data volumes grow across tenants.

·   Respond to database incidents as part of the on-call rotation and document root causes and corrective actions.

·   Maintain database runbooks, configuration records, and disaster recovery procedures.

**Must-Have Requirements**

·   12+ years of experience as a SQL Server DBA supporting production systems.

·   Hands-on experience with Always On Availability Groups and Windows Server Failover Clustering.

·   Strong T-SQL and performance tuning skills, including execution plans, Query Store, DMVs, and Extended Events.

·   Experience with backups, restores, and point-in-time recovery, including regular restore testing.

·   Experience managing large databases (hundreds of GB to multiple TB) under 24/7 workloads.

·   PowerShell scripting experience for DBA automation.

·   Willingness to work hours that regularly overlap with US Pacific business hours and participate in an on-call rotation.

·   Clear written and spoken English for collaboration with US-based engineering teams.

**Nice-to-Have Qualifications**

·   Experience with dbatools, Redgate tools, SolarWinds DPA, or SQL Sentry.

·   Experience with database CI/CD and migration tools such as Flyway, DbUp, or SSDT.

·   Experience supporting multi-tenant SaaS databases.

**Role Details**

**Experience:**
12+ years

**Location:**
Coimbatore / Hybrid

**Joining:**
Immediate to 30 days

Regular overlap with US Pacific business hours; participation in an on-call rotation

**What We Offer**

·   Competitive compensation.

·   Paid holidays and flexible paid time off.

·   Medical insurance for self and family, with coverage of up to ₹4 lakhs per person.

·   Casual dress code and a flexible working environment.

·   Direct collaboration with US-based engineering teams on a production SaaS platform.
